steps.name: The Adventurer Awakens
steps.objective: Turn in the quest to [Arche] in 「Pneuma」.

steps.name: An Old Friend's Story
steps.objective: Find [Notos] in 「Nereis Gatewayway」 and turn in the quest.

lines.text: (Pneuma, usually quieter than anywhere else, is abuzz. A crowd of spirits has gathered where Arche stands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aerura, what's happening? Why are all the spirits gathered here? Did Kairos do a somersault or something? He did, then left?
(A host of question marks appears above Aerura's head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's all you know? Then let's go see. There really are a lot of spirits in Pneuma. How many is this...?
(Squeezing through the crowd of spirits, the adventurer finds two familiar figures. The violet eyes they turn toward %s seem especially deep today.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Welcome, %s.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, did you rest well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I did, but how did you get here, Iris...?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: My power couldn't reach Pneuma before. But now that Elysia is connected to it, I can come here.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Though I still can't approach Elysia itself.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You're the only one who can go to Elysia right now, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels as though they want me to face those trials again...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Being allowed into a god's domain means you've been acknowledged.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry. I wish I could do more...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't say that, Iris. I'm sorry. If only I were stronger...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Neither of you is to blame for the bad things happening in this world.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you for understanding, Arche. But have we...?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Have we met somewhere? You seem so familiar. I'm sure this is our first meeting...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I wanted to keep it a secret, but in a way, I'm a distant relative of yours...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Oh, that's right. But that isn't a secret, is it?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I wanted to be a woman of mystery. It's a shame you found me out so quickly.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Ahaha, Arche...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Let's see each other often. I'll come visit.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Really?
(Iris takes both of Arche's hands. Arche looks at her with a radiant smile.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thank you. Apart from the spirits, I was always alone in Pneuma. Now %s visits, and you do too... I'm so happy!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hehe...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Oh, %s... Right. I came to tell you something. About Hilda and Levi...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I ask about?)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: When Elysia connected to Pneuma, I learned a great deal. I had many choices to make, and I saw pieces of the future that would unfold from them.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: All so intricately tangled...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: So I'm trying to unravel the threads wound around me. I've already resolved a few things.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Siam...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Siam?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I brought Siam out of the darkness. Witches and demons tried to interfere with my choice, but fortunately, it worked out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And I've asked Siam to handle matters concerning Hilda, so don't worry too much. I'll tell you about the other things as soon as they're resolved.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I promise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If Iris says so, it should be all right...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Levi? What about him?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Levi is traveling through Freios in search of Pandora. If what she's doing concerns him, he intends to stop her.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: What Pandora is trying to do...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I don't think she'll stop, even if it brings her closer to the night.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora told me not to get involved with the night...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Even she probably didn't realize then how far this would go.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: As long as Pandora is acting for Levi's sake, he isn't safe either. Other witches pursuing the night may target him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If Iris is bringing up Levi...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris... What can I do to help? Tell me...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You've only just had a little rest. I'm sorry to ask you to do something else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. It's for you.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Please persuade Levi to stop searching for Pandora and return to Jiendia...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Where is he now?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I don't know where Pandora is, but I've learned where Levi is headed.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: According to the spirits... he's going to Luria Village, along the Isar River.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll find Levi and try to persuade him.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll keep Hilda safely with me in the meantime. Don't worry too much. I won't let my adventurer be put in danger.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll be going now.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Goodbye, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: See you later, Arche.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you next time, Iris...
(Iris offers a gentle nod and slowly steps back. The spirits follow her away, as though seeing her off.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I suppose she can't stay away for long either.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I suppose not.
(After seeing Iris off, Arche returns and studies %s's face.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s, are you really all right now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Aerura helped me feel better.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Actually, this is a secret... Kairos and Chronos came to wake you at one point. They got tired of trying and went home, saying you'd wake when you were ready.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: They argued so loudly over waking you, %s, but you still didn't stir. Anyway, I'm glad you're feeling better.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now I feel a little guilty. Sigh. I'd better go too, Arche.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Travel safely. And don't push yourself too hard. Ask for help when you need it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll remember that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't know the way to Luria Village. Who should I ask? I'll try Notos at Nereis Gateway.)

steps.name: The Road to Laran Road
steps.objective: Find [Licota] in 「Nereis Gatewayway」 and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Welcome, %s. A cool breeze came in from the Void Sea, and I thought it might herald a welcome guest. And here you are, %s.
(Notos closes his spellbook and greets the adventurer with a warm smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Notos. Has everything been all right?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Yes. Thanks to you, %s, life here at Nereis Gateway has been peaceful for all of us. Oh, are you on your way somewhere?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Luria Village.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Ah, Luria... A village beside the Isar River. There are ruins nearby, so many archaeologists visit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there a gate here at Nereis Gateway that leads there?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I'm afraid there's no direct gate. But I can tell you the way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Notos.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: A path from Crystal Moon Forest leads to Laran Road. Follow that, and you'll reach Luria Village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh. I didn't see a path to Laran Road when I visited Crystal Moon Forest...

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: They say the fire in the forest long ago made the routes leading outside difficult to find.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Anyone who isn't from the village tends to get lost. Your best bet is to ask one of the elven forest keepers or someone who visits often.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. That's very helpful.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Come to think of it, Licota, who sometimes helps us at the gateway, said she was going to Laran Road today. Did you know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: She's been several times and knows the area well. Why not go with her?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll ask. I'm off to see Rico, Notos. See you later.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: My break is over too. I'd better go attend to the gates.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, about Zephyros... He probably wants to explain himself. I shouldn't say anything first, should I?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then let's find Licota...)

steps.name: Licota the Guide
steps.objective:
1. Use the gate in 「Nereis Gatewayway」 to reach 「Crystal Moon Forest」.
2. Use the gate in 「Crystal Moon Forest」 to reach 「Laran Road」. Be sure to find [Leon] on 「Laran Road」 and turn in the quest there.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Hello, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How have you been, Rico?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I've completed several missions while staying at the gateway. Both the visible kind and the less visible...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: And how have you been, Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A lot has happened.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: How much can you tell me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... Right. You...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: No need to be awkward about it... I want to help where I can. Have you met any more witches?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly tell Licota about meeting the witch Morgana in the Twilight Cathedral.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I had no idea anything like that had happened in Crystal Moon Forest...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: If such power was stirring in Lifthrasir and Crystal Moon Forest, surely the Moonlight members should have sensed something...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: For us to have noticed nothing... A witch's power really is remarkable. Just like what happened on Aie Island.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: And there isn't just one such witch, but several...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's nothing you need to do right now, Rico. If something comes up, I'll ask.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said you're going to Laran Road, right? Could you show me the way to Luria Village? I need to meet someone...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'm headed that way too. Would you like to come with me, or should I just give you directions?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go together.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Then follow me.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: First, we'll take the gate to Lifthrasir and head into Crystal Moon Forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Rico.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: If you're really grateful, pick up a pretty doll for me next time you find one... Let's go, then...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: See that path? Follow it straight ahead, and you'll reach Laran Road.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, so that's it. It's so obvious. Why didn't I see it before? Huh...
(Licota suddenly glances around.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: (It feels a little too strange to be my imagination...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You sensed something too, Rico?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes... But I don't think it's especially dangerous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it meant to attack us, it would have done so already.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I suppose so. Hmm...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'll guide you as far as the central part of Laran Road. Leon happens to be inspecting the facilities along the road today.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who's Leon?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: He's from Luria Village. When I asked him some questions on my way through, he kindly explained everything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Shall we go, then?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'll lead the way, %s.

steps.name: The Wolf Beastkin of Laran Road
steps.objective: Defeat [Bronze Madillo] and [Guiding Hyade] on 「Laran Road」, then return to [Leon] on 「Laran Road」 and turn in the quest.

lines.text: (A vast dam seems to hold back the river flowing between green mountains and hills. Flecks of spray drift over the travelers, bringing a refreshing coolness.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow... This is beautiful...

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: That was my reaction too. I was just passing through on a mission, but I couldn't help admiring the view.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: To build something so magnificent without harming the natural surroundings...
Oh, Rico-Licota? I've been seeing you a lot lately!
(At the familiar greeting to Licota, %s instinctively turns toward the voice.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
Ri-ri-Rico, who's this?
(The person taking such liberties with Licota's name steps forward from behind them.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Oh, Leon...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're Leon...? Huh?
(The adventurer looks up at the towering newcomer and finds someone far from ordinary.)

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: That's me. Leon. Are you an adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I am, but...

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Did you come with Rico-Rico?
(The wolf beastfolk grins and offers a handshake.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Leon. I'm %s...

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: %s, %s... I've heard that name before. Where was it?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: But aren't you surprised to see a beastfolk, %s? Shouldn't a werewolf this handsome and cute make more of an impression?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've met people like you on other continents. And I've seen other beastfolk near El Anor.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: People? Adventurer, did you just call me a person?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Wow! You're different from the others. Thank you! I love it! You're the best, Adventurer!
(Leon beams, grabs %s by both arms, and shakes them enthusiastically.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I noticed it during the handshake, but he's incredibly strong.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Leon, don't squeeze %s's hands so hard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... I'm all right.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Oh, sorry. I was just so happy you treated me like any other person. That's why I like Cori-Cori too.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Sigh... Leon. Please choose one name and stick to it. Rico or Licota.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Sure, Licota. What brings you here today?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Please show %s the way to Luria Village. I need to go elsewhere.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you're busy, Leon, directions will be fine.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: No, I just finished my rounds. Nothing much wrong, so I was about to head back. Good timing. I got to see Coco-Li too.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: It's Licota.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Leon, we're parting here today. But if you get my name wrong next time...

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: If I do...?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'll tie you up and toss you into the Abyss Chamber, Purgatory, or the Twilight Cathedral.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: I don't know where those places are, but they sound dangerous.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Then please take good care of %s, Leon.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Got it, Rico.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Rico.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: See you, Adventurer.
(With a farewell, Rico quickly heads toward a fork in the road in the distance.)

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Oh, right. I forgot I had a favor to ask Rico-Rico.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Lately, the wild animals we often see along Laran Road have turned aggressive. And strange monsters have appeared from who knows where...

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: They had me surrounded, and I was begging for help when Licota rescued me. So I thought maybe this time too...

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Adventurer, you didn't hear that. When we get to the village, you must never, ever tell anyone.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: They'll treat me like a puppy again. I'm a wolf, but they keep making me question my identity.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. So I need to calm the animals and deal with those things that look like monsters?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I feel a little tricked, but I'll help him.)

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Hehe. Go, Adventurer! You can do it!

steps.name: Making the Road Safe
steps.objective: Defeat [Drooling Hefring] and [Parupa] on 「Laran Road」, then be sure to turn in the quest to [Leon] in 「Luria Village」.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Wow, amazing! You're the best, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does that take care of it?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: You and Licota... What are young people eating these days to turn out so impressive?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (How old is Leon? It's hard to tell with a werewolf.)

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: What is it, Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you don't mind my asking, how old are you...?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Me? Twenty.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Sorry, sorry! I've been talking with Grandma Helena so much, I must have picked up the way she talks. Sorry!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... That happens.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Did you think I'd tossed my manners into the Void Sea?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, no. Not at all.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: I'm joking, Adventurer. I like you! You're great! Come on, let's go to the village.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Sorry, but we'll have to do that once more on the way. Matthias says the road into the village has to be safe for Jun...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who's Matthias, and who's Jun?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: I'll explain on the way. Come on! Hee!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He's awfully good at glossing things over...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Leon, wait for me! I don't know the way!

steps.name: Unease Returns
steps.objective:
1. Finish talking to [Leon] in 「Luria Village」, then go to 「Laran Road Clearing」.
2. Once the conversation in 「Laran Road Clearing」 is over, return to 「Luria Village」 and turn in the quest to [Matthias].

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Whew, we're here! Awoooo!
(Upon entering the village, the adventurer sees windmills turning in the breeze and waterwheels spinning in the current.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's beautiful here too. I want to take a walk right away...

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Isn't it? Some people have never visited Luria Village, but nobody visits only once. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Anyway, Adventurer, you're amazing. How did you handle so many of them so easily?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You were impressive too, Leon. Scaring off all those animals and defeating the monsters.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Oh, don't flatter me all the way up to the Void Sea. Compared with you, I'm just an ordinary local. Or an ordinary local beastfolk?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: So, Adventurer, what are you going to do in our village?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm looking for a friend.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: A friend? A friend of yours must be someone amazing, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. He is.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Shall I help you look?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Leon. Huh, Leon?
(Leon's movements suddenly slow, then stop altogether. As though someone were playing a trick, %s's vision distorts.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...
(The footsteps of everyone passing %s also slow to a halt. Just then, a familiar figure materializes beside the villagers.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne.
(At the sound of her name, the figure slowly approaches %s.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I meant to pass through quietly, but you recognized me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you here?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Just like last time, I have no business with you today. Oh, do you remember those words?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Judging by your expression, you do...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop wasting words and tell me what you're doing here...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: You want to hear my story that badly? Then I'll tell you somewhere outside the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell me here.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Such a suspicious person... Must I take this village hostage, though I'd never planned to, just to satisfy your demand?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: There's a place along Laran Road where no one goes. Follow the strange power you sense, and you'll find me...
(Daphne smiles and turns away, walking between the villagers. As her form fades like an illusion, the village's slowed time returns to normal.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to hurry.
(Collecting their thoughts and looking around, %s meets Leon's worried gaze.)

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Adventurer, why are you talking to yourself? Are you tired?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no. Leon, one question. Is there somewhere along the road that people don't visit?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: There is. An empty clearing with absolutely nothing in it. The Magic Bureau was going to build a warehouse there, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Magic Bureau?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Yes. Ah... Explaining that is Matthias's job... Do you need to hear about it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll hear it later. I'm in a hurry...

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: I'd like to show you the way, but I've got work to do in the village...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's all right. Just tell me how to get there.
(Leon's crooked map sends the adventurer wandering unnecessarily. Eventually, their steps come to a halt at what looks like the end of Laran Road.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here it is. An empty clearing, just as Leon said...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne, come out. Where are you?
(Just as the adventurer concludes that there is nothing here but a distant view of the river and dam, the air begins to change.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne, come out. Keep your word.
(As %s looks around, a woman's voice sounds behind them. It is not Daphne's.)
(A blonde woman in a black Gothic dress adorned with red ribbons and roses slowly passes %s.)
The rabbit witch never promised you anything. If she had made a true promise, she could not have broken it...
Are witches destined to encounter other witches?
Daphne, if you have business with me, Pandora, stop playing games and show yourself...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora...? Pandora?!
(As the woman who named herself Pandora finishes speaking, the veils surrounding them fall away one by one. A woman with twitching, long ears appears between them.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Hello, Pandora.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: This is our first meeting, isn't it? I wasn't sure what sort of encounter you'd prefer, so I gave it a great deal of thought. Do you like it, Pandora?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I dislike your toying with %s. But if it was to meet me, I'll give you credit for that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: %s, I know you have much to say to her, but please step back for a moment. That rabbit witch used you because of me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: %s, you're so kind to Pandora. You could show me that side of you too.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Enough pointless chatter... Daphne, how close have you come to the night?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Deep night is still far away. But with your help, I should manage.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The night you seek and mine are different. I don't see why you would ask for my help.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Because you are Levi's mistress.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: What did you just say?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Pandora, if you help me, there won't be a problem. No one will be hurt. Levi included...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Ugh...
(The moment Daphne mentions Levi, blood bursts from the wound on her cheek.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Say that again.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Hehe. Just as I expected. He is precious to you.
(Daphne wipes away the blood as though it were nothing.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: It sounds as though you wouldn't mind my killing you here...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Pandora, can you truly kill me?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: You know what would happen. If you kill me, you'll never see Levi again. And you'll never reach the goal you seek.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Where is Levi?!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: That depends on you now.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Pandora...
(Dense darkness gathers into a wall before Daphne. The witch's smile behind it stops Pandora and %s in their tracks.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Are you ready to open the box?
(With those words, the darkness shatters like glass. Daphne's figure behind it also breaks into fragments and scatters.)
(The lingering darkness fades, leaving the cold air of Laran Road.)
(Pandora stares at the sky, looking hollow.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I knew what I was facing when I left the mansion. Yet merely hearing Levi's name renders me helpless...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora, are you all right?
(Pandora gazes steadily at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I noticed it when we first met. You're always looking after others.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Perhaps that's what has kept you alive and made you strong.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you complimenting me?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Levi said I should praise people for their good qualities.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You seem... rather different.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Do I? As I regain my power, little by little, I've taken this form. Though returning to my original appearance may be difficult...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Still, I've recovered enough to reach the Freios continent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That isn't quite the change I meant...)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: %s, you should go back. Approaching the witches' night is still dangerous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know about the witches' fate.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: How much do you know? Don't tell me...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You've met the one who bestowed the fate of those who pursue the night. And you know that they kill one another...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I knew you were carrying out errands for the God of the Astral Realm, but I never expected you to learn this much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But, Pandora...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I know what you're going to ask. Whether I've killed any witches?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I do not kill witches. I never have.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You must find it hard to believe that an Agasura like me, given a witch's fate, has never done such a thing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll believe you.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And let's find Levi together. I came here to persuade him.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Explain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Levi is in Freios searching for you, other witches could target him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's why Iris asked me to persuade him to return to Jiendia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard he was coming to Luria Village, so I came here. I didn't expect to meet you instead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can you tell me why you're here?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: There's something I want to give Levi, somewhere along Laran Road. That's why I came. And I know what you're worried about.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Nothing I do for Levi will ever involve methods he would despise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Let's find him together. The rabbit witch may be playing another trick.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let's go to the village.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Crowds make me uncomfortable. I'd like you to speak to the villagers. I'm not used to such things...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, all right. I'll lead the way.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You really are difficult to understand...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Who should I talk to first when we get back?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, Leon kept mentioning someone named Matthias. He said he'd tell me who that was...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's find him first. Maybe he'll know something.)

steps.name: His Whereabouts
steps.objective: Talk to [Matthias], [Yeonhee], and [Helena] in 「Luria Village」 in that order. Then turn in the quest to [Juen] on 「Laran Road」.

lines.text: (A burly, muscular man studies the unfamiliar traveler approaching him.)
I haven't seen you before. A traveler?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's my first visit to Luria. You're Matthias, correct?

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: I'm the village chief... no, representative, Matthias. What brings you to me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, let me introduce myself. I'm %s...

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: %s, %s... That name sounds familiar...

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Anyway, it looks as though you're searching for something. I'll help. Did you come alone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I'm with...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Look ahead.
(Meeting the adventurer's eyes, Pandora gestures for them to face forward.)

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not with anyone. I'm looking for someone, Chief.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Chief... no, representative... Oh, just call me Matthias.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course, Matthias.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: I like "chief," but my daughter hates it. She says it makes me sound old-fashioned.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: So, what are you looking for?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A friend named Levi...

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Hmm... A name alone won't help much. What does he look like?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A young man with blond hair and blue eyes. He's handsome enough to make women fall in love at first sight and confess on the spot.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Ah... Then he's someone Jun mustn't meet. Jun is my lovely daughter. Her name is actually Juen, but everyone calls her Jun.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So the person Leon mentioned is Matthias's daughter.)

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Ah! I remember! I think that handsome fellow was in the village.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: A few days ago, the ladies all ran out squealing with delight. "Where are you going? Won't you look this way for a moment?" That sort of thing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just as I thought...

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: I don't know where he is now. I made the rounds today, but only saw the usual faces...

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: It's hard to keep track of where every visitor is staying. Sorry.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Jun could hand out snacks and get the children playing detective. They'd find him in no time. But she's out on the road right now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, thank you for the offer. I'll look around a little more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... Who should I ask next?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd better look around the village again.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Sorry, traveler! I made you fall, and broke your glasses too.
(Leon offers a hand to Yeonhee, who fell after colliding with him.)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: It's all right. I have spare glasses.
(Yeonhee smiles brightly and reaches for the person in front of her.)
(Startled, Pandora quickly steps back. Grasping only empty air, Yeonhee falls flat on the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeonhee, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Oh, that sounds like %s...
(Yeonhee rubs her eyes and seems to address %s, though she is looking at Leon.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm over here.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Without my glasses, it's rather hard to tell people apart.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Do I look like the adventurer...? Anyway, sorry. I'll pay for the glasses.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I'm really all right, but if you insist on compensating me... Those were specially made by the Silvaria Empire's Magic Bureau. About three billion Ely...

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: I don't have that much money... I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I'm joking. Actually, three hundred million Ely...

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Have mercy... That's expensive too. Waaah.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: It was partly my fault for not looking where I was going. Please don't worry.
(Yeonhee takes out another pair of glasses and puts them on.)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Phew, now I can see. Without my glasses, I can't see a thing... Would you tell me your name?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Leon.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Leon, Leon... What a nice name. Thank you for your concern, Leon. I'm Yeonhee, from Elias on the Jiendia continent.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: You seem to know the adventurer. Is that why you weren't surprised to see me?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: You're a guest in our village. If you need anything or have any questions, just call me. I'll take good care of you.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: I'm making fish for dinner. Want some?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Hehe. I certainly won't turn that down.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Great! Then I'll catch something good! When you get hungry, howl here. All right? See you!
(Leon waves and runs toward the river behind the village.)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I'm looking forward to trying the local fish dishes. But what was howling again...? Oh, when puppies go "awoooo." How adorable.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Yeonhee. How have you been?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I'm always well. And I didn't even get lost this time. I heard about Luria in the capital and came straight here. I'm glad I did.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: What brings you here, %s? It doesn't seem like an ordinary visit...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. You know Levi, don't you? Levi Arens...

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Of course. Anyone in Elias who doesn't know Levi must have less sense than an octopus. Has something happened to him?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No... I'm looking for him on personal business. I heard he came to the village a few days ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I thought I'd ask whether you knew anything.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I arrived late yesterday, so I haven't seen him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: If I see Levi, I'll tell him you're looking for him, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And if I find him, I'll give him your regards.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I hope you find him soon. It isn't anything bad, is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, no. Nothing like that.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: That's a relief. Oh, there's an elderly lady over there. Have you asked her?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: She's very kind. She helped me find my way around the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Yeonhee.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: You're welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Enjoy your trip. See you again, Yeonhee.
(Yeonhee waves goodbye to %s. Then, while cleaning her glasses with a small cloth, she gazes into the distance as though noticing something.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: (She didn't just meet my eyes, did she?)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Now I can finally see the scenery properly. I must write down all my impressions. Hehe.
(With her glasses back on, Yeonhee looks around and admires the village.)
(After watching Yeonhee head toward the fishing spot, Pandora hurries after %s.)
(An elderly woman notices an unfamiliar figure in the distance and looks up, closing the book she had been reading over tea.)
So that's the one...
(Unaware of the elderly woman's recognition, %s hurries onward. Pandora catches the collar of %s's clothing.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What is it?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: That woman is no ordinary person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't see any reason for concern.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: All right. You ask her, then. She shouldn't be able to see me anyway...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...
(The elderly woman sets her teacup on the table and studies %s's approaching face.)
Welcome, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello. Huh...? You know me?
I thought you had come knowing who I was. Apparently not.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure what you mean. I just wanted to ask the villagers something...
I see. Then let me introduce myself. I am Helena Silvaria.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I see... What?!
(The elderly woman who introduced herself as Helena smiles faintly, amused by %s's reaction.)

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Why so surprised? I'm the great-aunt of Her Majesty, Dayna, and Shiina.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you're a member of the imperial family. I thought you had a similar air.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Only in part, you might say. I wasn't born to the emperor's principal consort... Though my elder brother cared for me dearly. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Listen to me ramble. I've heard a great deal about you, %s. That's how I recognized you at once.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You thought I'd heard about you before coming...

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: So, what brings you here, %s? Personally, I hope it has nothing to do with the Empire.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It isn't imperial business. I'm looking for someone for personal reasons.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: It must be important. I don't know how much help I can be...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A young man traveling from Jiendia. Blond hair, blue eyes...

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Levi Arens, was it? A beautiful, graceful young man whose charm naturally drew people to him...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know him?

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I remember him. You rarely see such a handsome young man these days. I've met few people so beautiful in all my years.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Somehow, he knew I was a retired archaeologist. He asked me all sorts of questions about the ruins.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You were an archaeologist? Oh, I thought those things over there looked like artifacts...

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: You have a good eye. I've loved history and artifacts since I was young, so I made them my work.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I discovered the Aegir Ruins near the village. Studying their artifacts also revealed a few stories that Theodore would enjoy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's impressive. And you know the professor too.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I think of Theo as a nephew.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see... Have you seen Levi since then?

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: No, I haven't seen that young man since our conversation.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: If he'd returned to the village, the girls would have squealed with delight. And Juen would have spent dinner asking, "Grandma, did you see him?"

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Helena, may I enter the ruins? There's something I'd like to check.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: You don't need my permission. But if you go inside, be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there something in the ruins?

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: After I retired, other archaeologists were injured while investigating them. Artifacts and mechanisms we'd studied endlessly without understanding suddenly began to move...

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I meant to inspect them myself, but somehow Her Majesty found out and stopped me. She must have seen a vision.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: So she sent knights to investigate. They concluded that those things activate under certain conditions.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Still, it worries me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I see...)

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: The girls have told me how strong you are, but there's no harm in being careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will be. I'll be all right.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: If you say so...

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Do you see that enormous rock-like structure outside the village? Those are the Aegir Ruins.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I hope you find what you're seeking, %s. And if Juen is outside the ruins, please tell her to come home before sunset.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Helena.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: You're welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll pass your message on to Juen.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Thank you. Oh, look at the time... I should go and rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry I kept you...

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: No, no. It's only natural at my age. Hehe. Until next time, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rest well, Helena.
(Once Helena leaves, Pandora quietly taps %s on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora...?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You were right. Helena is no ordinary woman, but she poses no problem.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Let's go... I need to look inside the ruins. I can faintly sense Levi.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Can they sense each other's magic?)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, shall we go?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Yes.

steps.name: A Lost Angel
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Juen] on 「Laran Road」.
2. Defeat [Raphaella] in 「Aegir Ruins」, then turn in the quest to [Juen].

lines.text: You ungrateful little thing!!
(A short-haired girl in explorer's clothes shakes a creature that appears to be a kind of Priring.)
You don't even find your own food, and now you're turning your nose up at what I bring?! The Prirings in other places love this stuff!
(The winged Priring spits out what appears to be feed with a loud "ptooey.")
Dad told me over and over not to feed the Hefrings. Well, goodbye, Hefrings. No food for any of you tomorrow.
(The creature she calls a Hefring looks panicked, as though understanding her words.)
(But it quickly regains its composure and flops onto its back, belly exposed.)
Oh, you! Do you think that'll make me stop being angry? You're awful, Hefring.
Y-you're too cute!! You think I'll keep bringing food if you act like that?
(The girl rubs the Hefring's belly and shakes a treat taken from her pocket. Its eyes sparkle as it waves its forepaws.)
I'll give you some today, but just this once. Sigh. Those archaeologists really spoiled you rotten.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me, are you Juen? Jun?
Yes, I'm Juen. Jun too. Huh?

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Huh? Wooooow!! Woooow!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong, Juen?

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: You look like such an amazing adventurer that I couldn't help it! You're incredible!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've never heard that before. You caught me off guard. I'm %s...

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: %s? %s? Wooooow! Are you that person? The champion of justice who defeated all those villains? The goddess's maniac?! Huh? The maniac of justice?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: %s, "maniac"... Is that your new title?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... You've got the wrong idea. I'm an adventurer.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: I can't believe I'm meeting someone so amazing. I'm overwhelmed! What brings you to the ruins?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm looking for something. I've already spoken with Helena.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. She asked me to tell you to come home before sunset.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Of course. But, Adventurer! If you've spoken with Grandma, you know it's dangerous... Will you be all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be fine. I'm used to this sort of thing...

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Wow, so cool. I want to explore like you... But I suppose I can't?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Perhaps not right now, but someday you can. Don't give up.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Eee! What wonderful advice. Thank you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...This girl is a little overwhelming...)

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Oh, right! There are lots of hungry Hefrings inside, so be careful.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Apparently, the archaeologists who first came to the Aegir Ruins thought they were fascinating and fed them tasty treats.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: After that, they stopped foraging and started living off snacks from the archaeologists.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: My dad weighs as much as a heavy log, and these little guys weigh about the same.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: They're careful with people they see often, like me. But when they see someone new, they fly straight at them without holding back.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Would you believe more than a few explorers and Hefrings have collided and gone flying into the Void Sea?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be careful.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Adventurer, I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: When you get back from exploring, tell me what happened!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. That's easy enough. See you later, Juen.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Have a good trip, Adventurer!
(The Hefring, sprawled out eating its snack, waves a forepaw at the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Lazy Prirings? How curious...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I can sense Levi inside. We should hurry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Let's get inside...
(Inside the imposing Aegir Ruins, wind carrying the scent of damp earth blows through well-ordered passages.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are signs of age everywhere. They really are ancient ruins.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: It's gone. Levi's presence...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's keep going in.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: All right...
(Just as Pandora steps forward, an enormous lance drops in front of them.)
Boom!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what...?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: It missed us, fortunately. Don't be frightened.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: A weapon imbued with holy power... That explains it. Is this why Levi's presence vanished?
(A woman with a catlike face approaches from inside the ruins, beating snow-white wings.)
(With an air reminiscent of the battle angel Michaela, she effortlessly pulls the enormous lance from the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A battle angel...?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I've lived a long time, but this is my first encounter with a battle angel...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's another one in a hidden place.
(The battle angel stares at them, then raises her lance.)
Listen to Raphie. This place is dangerous. Humans don't belong here... W-wait. What are you?!
(The battle angel in vivid red armor looks bewildered.)
Raphie knows every human blessed by the gods... Human, what are you? And why are you with a demon?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You don't know what an Agasura is...? And who is Raphie?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: What's an Agasura? Raphie doesn't know anything about that. And Raphie is me. I'm Raphie.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: There's no time, %s... Leave the battle angel. We need to find Levi.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Levi? What's Levi? Is that what you're looking for?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: If a human blessed by the gods and a demon are searching together, it must be something very important.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Maybe it could help Raphie get out of here... I have to leave quickly and help Lord Orca.
(The moment she finishes speaking, the battle angel beats her wings hard and flies deeper into the ruins.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me! Raphie!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that angel thinking? I don't understand. If she can't leave, does that mean she's trapped...?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: %s, stop thinking and come on. There's no need to puzzle over it here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. Let's hurry. We need to find Levi before she does.
(They search the Aegir Ruins thoroughly, but find no sign of Levi. Only suspicious artifacts and mechanisms, awakened by some unknown will, greet them.)
(Along with Hefrings rushing to greet people... or rather, the food those people carry.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everyone had good reason to warn us. But where is Levi?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora...?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I can sense his soul. He must be here... Why can't we see him?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you sure he came here?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I don't know... I thought I knew everything about Levi...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora, stop!
Boom!
(Just as when they first entered the Aegir Ruins, an enormous lance falls in front of Pandora.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Raphie has to leave this place. I have to get out and help Lord Orca.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: So... even if you have nothing to do with Raphie, if you get in my way, I'll defeat you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Raphie, that's not...

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Only Raphie gets to call Raphie "Raphie"!
(The battle angel beats her wings, gathering the immense energy within the ruins into a fierce gale.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Everything in my way can blow away!!
(At the battle angel's words, the fierce wind sends Pandora flying before she can raise a magical barrier.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora!!
(Pandora is blown so far away that she vanishes from sight.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: She was annoying, so I sent her far away. Now it's just you and Raphie. I'm going to find this Levi thing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Levi isn't a thing...
(Once more, a sharp lance whistles past %s.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Being blessed by a god doesn't give you the right to interfere with me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I have no choice. I'll have to find a way to hold you back.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Try it if you can. I won't make it easy!!
(The battle angel's lance is knocked aside by %s's counterattack.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: What are you? This shouldn't be possible. How can you stand against Raphie's attacks?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please, listen to me. Fighting like this won't get us anywhere.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Raphie doesn't want to listen! Ugh, you're such a nuisance. What should I do?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Oh, right! That'll work.
(The battle angel's wings suddenly grow enormous. One beat gathers the immense energy within the ruins into another fierce gale.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: You can get out too!! And don't come back!
Thud.
(The wind raised by the battle angel sends %s flying, then crashing to the ground somewhere else.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh... What was that...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, this is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The ruins' exit. Who just blows someone away in the middle of a fight...? Sigh. I have to get back inside.
(The adventurer tries to retrace their path, but a barrier of unknown power blocks the way.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Neither of us can return the way we came. We can't do anything like this.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: First, we need to talk to the angel and clear up the misunderstanding... She appeared so abruptly, but it cannot be a coincidence.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should we do?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I'd like to ask the angel you mentioned for help...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Michaela may have an answer. But, Pandora...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could Levi have left already?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: No. If he sensed my power, he would never leave Laran Road.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: But something is strange...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I'll explain when you return. I'll search Laran Road in the meantime, just in case.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

steps.name: Clearing Up a Misunderstanding
steps.objective: Find [Aurum] in 「Eidos Sanctuary」 and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Then let's meet back here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll head to the Sanctuary... She's gone...
(Pandora vanishes without a trace as soon as she finishes speaking. Juen, sitting nearby with a book, notices the adventurer and looks puzzled.)

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: You're back already?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I rushed in too quickly. I'll make proper preparations first.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: It sounded rather noisy inside... Did something happen?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The mechanisms seem to be moving. It's dangerous, so don't go inside under any circumstances.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Really? Will the Hefrings be all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry about them. They're quite good at staying out of the way.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: ...They can dodge on their own? How unexpected, Hefrings. Well, Adventurer, good luck with your preparations.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Juen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd better hurry to the Sanctuary.
(After the adventurer leaves, a Hefring stops eating and looks toward the ruins, as though spotting something.)

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Hefring, what's wrong? Is something over there? I don't see anything...
Priring, you can see me, can't you? Then listen carefully. You know what you need to do here for this girl.
(Meeting the boy's eyes, the Hefring nods.)
Good, Priring. Well done.
(Apparently unaware of the boy, Juen sits beside the Hefring and resumes reading.)
(The boy, with bandages around his face and leg, leaves Juen and the Hefring behind and walks toward the river.)
A being in this world unknown to both me and the battle angel... A great deal of time really must have passed.
I thought escaping to the Demon Realm would be enough... only to end up trapped in the garden.
In any case, I need to know what happened while I was gone...
(The boy takes a deep breath and raises a chalice-like cup. The empty vessel fills with clear water.)
O star of twisted fate, show me the memories you hold.
(The boy closes his eyes and drinks. Then he opens them and pours the remaining water onto the ground.)
A world with almost no gods left...
Dead or fled, and those who remain are barely present... Hahaha, how interesting.
Well, I'd better return to the garden and watch what that being created by Hecate's will is doing.

steps.name: Mika and Rafi
steps.objective: Find [Juen] in 「Aegir Ruins」 and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aurum, how have you been?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Oh, you know...
(Aurum gazes forlornly at the sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're confined here again.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I returned to the capital for the first time in a while and had business in the commercial district. A thief appeared, and I chased them, determined to catch them...

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I may have overdone it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How badly did you overdo it to end up confined again?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: This was no ordinary thief. A beastfolk boy flying around on an enormous magic golem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No Name and Licaria?)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Trying to catch him caused quite a commotion. Argent grabbed me and got angry, asking what I'd have done if I got hurt...

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Still, he defended me in front of the Magic Bureau and the council, so it ended well. Though I spent half a day listening to him lecture me about leaving things to him.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Anyway, what brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've come to see Michaela.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: She should be here soon.
(Aurum looks up. Michaela can be seen flying toward them from afar. Recognizing her visitor, she approaches with a smile.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Welcome, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Michaela.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mica's happy you're here, %s... What brings you? Huh, %s... What's this feather? This belongs to a battle angel...
(Michaela plucks a feather from %s's clothing. It resembles her own, though it looks a little rougher.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s, did you meet Raphie?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Here's how it happened...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Michaela about meeting the battle angel in the Aegir Ruins.)
(Tears gather in Michaela's eyes, a rare change in her expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Michaela?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mica's all right. Hearing that Raphie is back... I couldn't help it. I'm so happy...

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I thought she vanished the day the continent was destroyed...
(Michaela wipes away her tears and gently handles the other battle angel's feather.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: The gods went to the Atlas Garden after the Twisted One, who was trying to flee to the Demon Realm. Raphie was waiting nearby...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A garden?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: The Atlas Garden... Mica's never been there, but I know it holds the gods' truth.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I don't know why the Twisted One went there, but it's obvious... He must have meant to tamper with that truth...

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Every god who went there perished. At the hands of the Beast, whom Iris called the Demon King...

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I thought Raphie had too... Oh, there's no time for this. Mica will help you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How?
(Michaela approaches %s and lightly kisses their cheek.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: M-Michaela! You startled me.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Again? Shouldn't you be used to Mica by now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: S-sorry. It was just so sudden...

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: If you spent some time confined at the Sanctuary too, %s, it wouldn't bother you at all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll pass...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Michaela? This is one of your wing feathers.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Before, Mica gave you one after a fight. We won't do that today. Show this feather to Raphie. And call her by her real name.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Raphaella.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Raphaella...

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Then Raphie will help you, %s.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I wish I could come with you, but I can't. Mica's sorry...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I'll hurry back and tell Raphaella about you.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Thank you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Aurum, Michaela.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Goodbye, %s.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Safe travels, %s.
(Michaela waves as the adventurer leaves Sanctuary Eidos.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I'm glad the angel who disappeared has returned.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mica's glad Raphie is alive too... But... what happened to the garden...?

steps.name: A Battle Angel's Way
steps.objective: Defeat [Raphaella] in 「Aegir Ruins」, then turn in the quest to [Juen].

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: %s, when did you get here?
(Juen closes her book and approaches %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just now. Has anything happened while I was away? Strange sounds from the ruins, perhaps...?

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: No, nothing. If there had been, I wouldn't have been sitting here reading so comfortably.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Hmm, not yet?
(Juen tilts her head at %s's searching glances.)

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Huh? Not yet?
(Pandora appears behind Juen without warning. She extends a hand toward %s and gestures for them to enter the Aegir Ruins.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, never mind.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Wow... Adventurer, could you be any cooler?!
(Juen's eyes sparkle.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: You were checking for just the right moment, weren't you? What incredible adventures taught you how to do that?

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: So amazing. And so modest, saying it's nothing...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Explaining this would be awkward. I'd better hurry...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Listen carefully, Juen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you hear a commotion inside the ruins, go straight back to the village. All right? It could become dangerous.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: I'll remember, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm going inside now. See you later, Juen.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Enjoy your exploration, Adventurer!
(As Juen says goodbye, the Hefring sprawled beside her with its snack also waves a forepaw.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew... Here we go...
(Inside the ruins, Pandora studies %s's face.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...Something about you seems a little different.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The battle angel at the Sanctuary told me what to do. Oh, you said you'd search the road. Did you find anything?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Well...
(Just as Pandora is about to answer, a powerful wind blows from within the ruins.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The battle angel's wind again... Unlike before, it doesn't seem to affect us.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: It must be because of the method you discovered.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it is.
(Realizing that %s and Pandora have withstood the wind, the battle angel flies toward them.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Mica? You're not Mica... How do you have Mica's power...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Raphaella, please listen. I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: I know what Mica's feather in your hand means. But Raphie still can't accept it.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: So fight Raphie once more. Let me see for myself...

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: That's how battle angels like Mica and Raphie do things. But not here. If our powers clash here, the magic gathered in this place will explode.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: That's the sort of place this is. It's too close to the garden...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Where should I go?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Remember where we fought before? It's the widest, deepest part of the ruins. Come there. I'll go ahead and wait.
(At %s's nod, Raphaella quickly flies deeper inside.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: This has become troublesome, but I'll help you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I'll do it. I have Michaela's feather, so I need to fight Raphaella myself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She said that's the battle angels' way...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Understood. If that's their way... I'll lead us there, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Pandora.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shall we go?
(The moment their eyes meet, the battle angel launches a sharp attack at %s.)
(Raphaella and %s clash with all their strength, shaking everything within the ruins.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Somehow, I've ended up watching servants of the gods fight each other.
(As the battle drags on, fatigue begins to show on Raphaella's face. While she pauses for breath, %s launches a powerful attack.)
Thud.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Is it over...?
(Raphaella blocks %s's attack, but her strength gives out and she falls backward.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Ahahahaha! Raphie lost.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Raphaella, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine. I'm just too worn out to stand. Give me your hand.
(With a bright smile, Raphaella takes %s's hand and rises.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She seems perfectly fine...)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: I told you, Raphie's fine. Mica likes you, so I must have misunderstood. Now, give Raphie Mica's feather.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for understanding. Here...
(Raphaella accepts Michaela's feather from %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now I should say your name, right, Raphaella?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: You've already said my name. There's one other thing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?
(Raphaella approaches %s and kisses their cheek, just as Michaela did.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaah! Y-you startled me!

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Raphie's greeting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh... How many more times before I get used to that...?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You're popular with angels... Anyway, Raphie? Raphaella? Battle angel... I have a question.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: You seem like a demon, but should Raphie think of you as a friend of Mica's friend for now?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: A friend of a friend? Something like that... Why are you here?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Raphie was ordered to wait here before going to the Atlas Garden.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I need to explain that... Raphaella, listen carefully.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Hm?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a very long time since you and Michaela last saw each other. A thousand years? Perhaps more...

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: No. Just a few days ago...
(Raphaella lowers her head, apparently realizing something.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: That explains it... Something felt strange. There used to be nothing by the river here.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: We were pursuing the Twisted One, who had concealed his power near the Atlas Garden. I was resting nearby...

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Then darkness suddenly came.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: And I heard a god scream...

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: It was such a terrible sound that Raphie thought it was a dream...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Beast...

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Perhaps a dream would have been better. No matter how hard I tried, I couldn't get out.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Then I saw you two. I thought you were the ones keeping me here.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Raphie's a fool, isn't she? A battle angel meant to protect the gods, wanting to believe their screams were only a dream...

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: I'd never heard a god scream like that...

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Oh, this light...
(A small orb of light appears beside the grieving Raphaella and begins circling her.)
(The moment Raphaella cups the little light in her hands, a soft, comforting voice rings out.)
It wasn't your fault, Raphaella.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Lady Seres...? No. That isn't Lady Seres's voice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Iris...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Raphaella, this is Iris. She succeeded Seres as God of the Astral Realm.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: What about Lady Seres? Lady Seres...

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: I'm sorry, Raphaella... There's no time for a long explanation. Instead, I'll give you some of the world's memories that reached the Great Wall.
(At Iris's words, the light rises from Raphaella's cupped hands and circles her as though wrapping her in an embrace.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Oh... Oh... So much happened while Raphie was gone...

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Lady Seres, Lady Gaia... Lady Iris...
(Clutching her lance, Raphaella weeps like a child. The little light circles her comfortingly, then comes to rest at her side.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Waaaaaaah!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris... What will happen to Raphaella now?

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: Both battle angels are bound to their lands by powerful fates... Michaela to the Sanctuary, and Raphaella to the area around the Aegir Ruins...

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Raphie can't leave here?

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: That isn't quite it. You can't leave immediately, but I promise I'll find a way for you to meet Michaela at the Sanctuary.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Thank you, Lady Iris! Raphie can wait!

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: I'm the one who's grateful. And...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I never imagined that child of the Tyr would become this... We can exchange greetings later.

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: Of course, Pandora...

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: Raphaella, %s... This light will fade soon. I acted in haste and couldn't prepare it properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. Once we find Levi... Ah...
(Before %s can finish, the little light in Raphaella's hands evaporates.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: ...Oh, I wanted to talk a little longer...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Angel, have you seen anyone besides %s and me?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Raphie hasn't seen anyone else... Oh?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: I didn't see anyone, but I once hid after sensing an extremely powerful presence. Different from the energy you two have...

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: It wasn't demonic power or a god's blessing. It vanished at once, so I went to look and found this lying there.
(Pandora startles at the object Raphaella gives her.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I saw that when I visited Poe Mansion...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Until my battle with you, I kept sinister energy inside this. But not anymore. Now it's only an empty box...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Why did Levi have this...? Where could he have gone...? Levi...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora, calm down.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I can't. In this situation, all I can do is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll help you. That's why I'm here.
(Just as Pandora is about to speak, the quiet Aegir Ruins begin to shake.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what is it?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Raphie will go outside and check. Lady Iris said staying near the ruins would be all right.
(Raphaella beats her wings hard and flies toward the exit. But she strikes something and is hurled back inside.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Ugh... Wh-what? But this is...
(Just as Raphaella tries to fly outside again, she suddenly drops to the ground.)
Thud.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Raphaella? Raphaella!!

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: My strength is draining... Ah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Raphie's all right...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Angel, what's outside?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: The garden...

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: I saw the Atlas Garden. The Twisted One's power is surging there, mixed with another force... It's keeping Raphie from approaching...
(Raphaella struggles to continue speaking.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stay here, Raphaella. Pandora, you have something to tell me, don't you?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: We need to go and see.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: ...Be careful. That place...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Michaela told me about it. I'll check what's happening outside. Rest here in the meantime, Raphaella.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You'll be all right here, won't you?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: I think I can recover... Raphie will rest here. I'm sorry I couldn't help...
(Raphaella closes her eyes and falls asleep.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: %s, follow me. There's something I need to do there. Oh...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: First, there's something you should do. Tell the girl outside the ruins to return to the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. But where are you going?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The clearing where we met Daphne.
(Having finished speaking, Pandora hurries toward the ruins' exit.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The garden Raphaella mentioned... I suppose I have to see it for myself...

steps.name: Daphne's True Purpose
steps.objective:
1. Finish talking to [Juen] on 「Laran Road」, then go to 「Laran Road Clearing」.
2. Watch what happens in 「Laran Road Clearing」, then turn in the quest to [Pandora] in front of the 「Atlas Garden」 entrance on 「Laran Road」.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Adventurer, are you all done?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: More or less.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: That means there's something left, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is, but you mustn't go inside, Juen. It's still full of dangers.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: That only makes me more curious, but I'll do as you say. I won't go into the ruins for at least a few years.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: I can gain experience later. It doesn't have to be now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Juen. I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: What is it, Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please don't ask why right now. I'd like you to go straight back to the village.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: All right. I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: In return, once everything's finished and I'm back in the village, I'll tell you some interesting stories.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: About traveling through Eastland and meeting the Champions...
(Juen's eyes sparkle as she listens.)

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Wow... Wow, wow, wow! Really?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll give you a souvenir from Eastland too.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: A-Adventurer, you're amazing! The absolute best! I'll go straight home, then. Promise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Promise.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Woooow, Hefring! Did you hear that? Did you?
(The Hefring gives Juen a completely uncomprehending look, then flops down again.)

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Hehe. Adventurer, get everything sorted out and come straight to our house. All right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Juen.
(Juen heads briskly toward the village with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's that in the sky? It wasn't there when I first came... Then that must be...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Atlas Garden...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd better hurry to Pandora. I hope this doesn't put another village in danger...
(Pandora looks up at the sky from the clearing, then gives %s a bitter smile as they approach.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora...?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I suddenly feel as though I'm being used...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By whom?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Someone who wants to move me, you, and everyone in this world like pieces on a chessboard...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You trusted me and helped me. I want to tell you my story. Will you listen?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...
(At %s's reply, darkness gathers around Pandora and %s.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: These shadows won't affect you. There's no need to be afraid.
(Pandora smiles softly. The shadows surrounding them deepen until only their voices remain.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: About the witches, about Levi... and why I'm approaching the night. Which would you like to hear first?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I ask about?)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: As you know, I am an Agasura.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Most Agasuras are those called sinners. Those who die for their sins wish simply to die, but some cannot. They become beings condemned to keep committing those same sins.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Every sinner you know is like that. Myself included... What my sin was can wait for another time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Beings who can only live by sinning eternally. We are not even permitted to be reborn. To end this life, we must grant another's wish and vanish...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: From the moment I became an Agasura, I wanted my existence to be brief. I tried to disappear, but at some point, another fate took hold of me.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: A witch's life, compelled to approach the night...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The gods of Etoile had the power to interfere with life, but did not tamper with it directly. Yet the Goddess of the Black Moon...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hecate...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: To hear Hecate's name from your lips... You have met her. Well, if you've met Daphne, I suppose I should have guessed you knew Hecate too.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Yes. Hecate meddled with my fate and those of many others. A god's power might have been a blessing, but this was a curse.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: To kill and be killed, and survive amid it all... We who were cursed had to survive to escape the curse...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: That's why I told you not to get involved. Everyone who became involved died...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora, suppose... just suppose... only one witch were left. What would happen?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: They haven't all died yet, so I can't be certain. But she would likely become something close to a god. A slain witch's abilities pass to her killer...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's why Morgana's power went to Daphne... Oh, then your ability...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: None of the witches wants my ability. It is the life of an Agasura itself...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Even so, I have no intention of becoming the last witch. Levi would never want that...
(When the adventurer asks about Levi, Pandora hesitates. Then she begins, apparently determined to explain properly.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Unlike the other Agasuras, who traveled across the continents doing evil, I always stayed in the mansion.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I didn't want to go out of my way to create sins. Then I found the perfect place for a witch fated to sin.

lines.speaker: 판도라
