lines.text: Poe Mansion... The strange estate left behind by the mage Allen. Vampanella awoke from his coffin and volunteered to serve me.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: We spread rumors to draw people in. Meet the great witch in the Gothic Room, and she would grant your wish...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: It was a reasonable arrangement. Vampanella needed blood, and I was an Agasura.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Those who came with petty wishes died before they could even make them, outside the Gothic Room. I thought them weak. Full of greed, and nothing more...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Then one day, a man reached the Gothic Room covered in blood. Anyone strong enough to reach me interested me.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: On the threshold of death, that young man held out a baby to me.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: He cried, "My child doesn't have long to live. Take my life, but please save him."

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: People's wishes had never interested me before. But this time was different. The baby awoke, looked at his father, and laughed. That sound captivated me.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I told the man I wanted his soul and the child's. He hesitated, then agreed, on the condition that I take them only when their lives reached their natural end.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: That was fine with me. I had no use for their souls anyway.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: But something else made him hesitate. He couldn't bear the thought that, in return for living, his child would lose his deep emotions and radiant smile.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Still, he wanted his child to live, whatever the cost. In the end, he had to make the choice himself.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: As the baby's smile faded, I realized something. But I dismissed it as unimportant.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: And so the baby lived, losing his deep emotions as agreed. He became a child who no longer cried.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: That is the story of Levi and his father, Lian...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The Arens father and son were bound to me by a contract, but I don't think they saw it as a curse. Perhaps that was only my interpretation...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: For some reason, they were so grateful that they kept visiting me. And so I watched Levi grow up.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Then one day, Levi came and told me he was going on a journey with a girl of the Tyr to find the Demon King...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Agasuras know Iris instinctively. She is the sole survivor of a sacred people with the power to stop sinners from sinning again.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: So it would be no surprise if the new God of the Astral Realm passed judgment on an Agasura like me this very moment. I don't know how many of the Tyr died by my hand...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: But before that, there's something I must do. That is why I'm approaching the night.
(Pandora raises her head toward the sky.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: After Levi left, a strange feeling gripped me for a while. I didn't understand it at first, but I soon learned.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Levi had been killed by the Demon King...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Only then did I realize that all power tied to the Agasuras flowed into the Demon King... Everything, including Levi's soul bound to me...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: It must be difficult to understand. Even I find this world, now without a Demon King, bewildering.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: But Levi returned. Neither his soul nor his body had been destroyed...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: %s, did you know?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The Beast was reborn as the Demon King because it merged with a complete soul of the Tyr.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Levi was ill, and his soul wasn't absorbed by the Demon King... because it was incomplete.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This... This makes no sense. How could something like this happen...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Barely calming my surging emotions, I tell Pandora what happened with Hilda.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Those beings above inflict such relentless, cruel suffering on the lives of this world.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: If Levi meets someone whose soul has a similar color, he too will crumble. And so will I, bound to him by contract...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: From the moment I touched Lian's and Levi's souls, I was already acting according to those beings' will...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The transcendent being who sent me to this place...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I won't lose Levi to that being. So I'll make his soul complete.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Restore his emotions, and let him live fully as a human...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I could find and kill a witch with the power to merge souls, then take that ability... But I will find another way.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I will never use methods Levi would hate...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You care about him deeply.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I-it isn't that I care. We're bound by a contract, so I... I have to honor it...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Protecting Levi is only natural as his contract holder...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. No need to get flustered.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Wh-what?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Anyway, I believe the means I seek lies there. Concealing the truth of this hideous world...
(Pandora looks up at the sky, then quietly gestures to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Someone has been here from the start. To think I never noticed while we spoke...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I need to see who's there...
(At Pandora's gesture, the surrounding darkness vanishes. An unexpected figure appears, looking distressed.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, why are you here?
%s? %s? P-please save me!!

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Who are you?
I'm an inspector of the Jiendia Empire. Levi...
(Pandora's face hardens at the name Inspector Levi.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Damn it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Give me a name other than that one!!
Y-yes? Other than Levi... Ah... T-Tation.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Very well, Tation. Tell me why you're here.

lines.speaker: 테이션
lines.text: The Empire sent a request, so I was heading ahead to Glaston. Then a woman with rabbit ears suddenly appeared and asked if I would be her servant...

lines.speaker: 테이션
lines.text: When I asked what she meant, she said she was joking, then made me unable to move. I don't remember much after that...

lines.speaker: 테이션
lines.text: When I opened my eyes, I was here. You two were talking. I called for help, but you couldn't hear me...
(Pandora's furious voice shakes the clearing. The surrounding scenery shatters like glass, its pieces falling to the ground one by one.)
(Once every fragment has fallen, a smiling woman with twitching rabbit ears appears behind them.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: You truly are no ordinary witch. Pandora the Agasura.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: What are you thinking?
(Daphne looks at the fallen Tation with pity. But when a hostile weapon is aimed at her, she turns her gaze to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne, where is Levi?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Haven't I told you? I have no business with you here. Hehe.
(Daphne pushes %s's weapon aside with the tip of her staff.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Pandora, I'd like to hear your answer.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: First, tell me what you've done with Levi.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Heh...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: The person you seek is wandering the Atlas Garden floating above us. He believes you're there.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Now, let me speak, Pandora... I need you. Let us welcome the night together.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I'll give you this man as a gift. Come to me, for the sake of your precious Levi. As though their souls had always been one...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Kill him.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I won't do that. I won't do anything Levi would not want.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: So you intend to open the box in the garden.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Very well. It's troublesome, but I'll give you another task. A new task for you too, %s.
(Daphne taps her staff. Enormous droplets leap from the Isar River behind her.)
(The droplets enclose the fallen Tation and rise into the sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what is it?
(Daphne watches him ascend with satisfaction, then slowly retreats.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Those whose souls share a color will soon meet, Pandora. I needn't tell you the result, do I?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: The one with the weaker soul will die.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Now, everyone. Come to the garden.
(With those words, Daphne vanishes from the clearing without a trace.)
(As Daphne disappears, the uneasy presence surrounding the clearing vanishes as well.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The same tricks again, Daphne.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: She must have intended this from the start.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: %s, we need to reach the garden quickly... I meant to go there anyway, but now there's no reason to hesitate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something I want to know first. What is the box in the garden?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Records the gods left about life and souls.
(No sooner has Pandora answered %s's question than she hurries out of the clearing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then it's a legacy of the gods... Is it all right for us to seek it out like this?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Saving those people comes first... Everyone, just hold on...)

steps.name: The Garden's Guardian
steps.objective:
1. Finish talking to [Pandora] on 「Laran Road」, then defeat [Metheus] in 「Atlas Garden」.
2. Turn in the quest to [Pandora] on 「Laran Road」.

lines.text: (An enormous droplet floats before Pandora, pulsing with energy.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora, there you are. Is this...?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Yes. A door to the Atlas Garden. The garden seems to be the reason the Isar River held so much magic.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The other questions can wait.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Face this droplet, beating like a heart, and we should reach the garden.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Come. To the garden of the gods...
(Pandora reaches out. The pulsing droplet opens as though it has been waiting, swallowing the two travelers bound for a place they were never invited to enter.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Have we arrived?
(The water surrounding them disperses, revealing a remarkable sight.)
(A structure resembling a windmill turns on a building that looks far from ancient. Beneath it, a vast reservoir supports everything.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Incredible. I never imagined a place like this...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: If this amazes you, you still have far to go... There is more of the world you don't know than you do. It is larger and deeper than you imagine.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Beyond cool... It's cold here. What did the gods leave in this place?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Pandora... Someone's over there.
(As %s looks around, a figure approaches from the distance.)
(A boy with bandages around his face and leg runs toward %s, looking pleased.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: He is no ordinary person. Be careful.
Welcome. I've been waiting for you. This is the Atlas Garden, where the gods' truth resides.
Well, only those in the know are aware of it. Oh, not people. Only gods.
Like it or not, only those connected to the gods can come here.
People blessed by gods, like you. Or witches saddled with pointless fates by a god's games...
Though technically, you're just a remnant of the Beast that devoured the gods.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?
Oh, right. I know you, but you don't know me. I should introduce myself.
Witch, say the name that comes to your mind.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Menoiti?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (W-wait. This is... like when I met Hecate. But I don't feel as much power as I did then.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: My name is Menoiti. Call me Meno for short. Call me Iti, and I'll get angry.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...Telling me to speak the name that comes to mind. You're a god.
(Menoiti smiles brightly at Pandora's composure.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Yes. Long ago, I was called a god. Somehow, I ended up being called the Twisted One instead.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Gods or humans, no one can like everything. I only said no a few times... Sigh.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: There are so many lovely names in the world. What exactly is twisted about me? Look closely. Does someone this pretty look twisted to you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Meno, what are you going to do to us?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Did you think someone called the Twisted One must be up to something? Hehe. Correct.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: How capricious.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: I've awakened after so long in a world where my friends were eaten or fled. Shouldn't I try everything I can?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: A remnant of the Beast born from Hecate's curse... Oh, that's far too long. I'll just call you a witch. Pandora the Witch.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: What you're looking for is here. But there's a problem. When the Atlas Garden awoke, its gardener awoke too.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Gardener?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Metheus the gardener cuts down anyone who covets the world's truth and souls. Even a god who gave it its sharp edges.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: What truth did they want to hide so badly that they'd kill even gods for it? Aren't you curious?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Back then, I risked my life trying to find it and flee to the Demon Realm. It was safer there than being killed by the Beast.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: They brought battle angels and Saint Valkyries just to catch me. And the gardener was rampaging too.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Well... That all failed. So now I'm giving up on truth and everything else, and just enjoying life. The gardener must have realized I've quit, because it leaves me alone.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: The Beast is gone, and there's no one left to kill me. No need to struggle. I won't be greedy.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: But while you're here, I'll play a few tricks beside the gardener. Do forgive me.
(Finishing his monologue, Menoiti raises his chalice. The vessel, empty only a moment ago, fills with clear water.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: O star of twisted fate.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: O star bearing the fate of destruction, beloved and praised by all.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Menoiti, who cherished you, commands...
(As Menoiti continues, the water in his cup surges and takes the shape of a dragon.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what...? This feeling...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: A god's...
(A paralyzing terror settles over Pandora and %s, then suddenly releases them.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Oh... What came next? Ah, I can't remember.
(Menoiti chuckles and drinks the water that was surging in his cup only moments ago.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: I'll keep my games mild today, then head back. So don't hate me too much.
(Menoiti spills the remaining water onto the ground. Droplets leap up, surround him, and vanish with him inside.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: He's determined to interfere. Levi... Levi?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I can sense Levi over there. That way.
(As Pandora looks in one direction, a voice resembling Levi's comes from the distance.)

lines.speaker: 레비의 목소리
lines.text: 「Lady Pandora, please don't make the wrong choice believing it's for my sake...」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that Levi's voice?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: There's no mistaking it. It's Levi. How can we hear him from here? Could Daphne...?
(With uncertainty in her eyes, Pandora rushes ahead. Before %s can say anything, she is already moving, and they hurry after her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora...
(While checking every path and structure in the Atlas Garden, they are constantly pursued by its inhabitants, including the Twisted One.)
(After a long struggle dodging enemies and forcing their way through violent spray, they finally reach the last unexplored corner.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora, I think this is the only place left... But there's nothing here.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...There's a hidden wall. I can sense Levi behind it...
(Pandora extends her hand. An invisible wall appears, then collapses the moment it is revealed.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Levi... Levi should be here... Why are you here instead?

lines.speaker: 테이션
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 테이션
lines.text: I'm fine, but that woman... Is her name Pandora?

lines.speaker: 테이션
lines.text: I've heard of her. A witch who lived in a remote mansion, luring people with wishes and killing them...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Think whatever you wish.

lines.speaker: 테이션
lines.text: Where are we? His Majesty once spoke of a conflict between witches... Why are you using me in that fight?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Your emperor knows things he shouldn't. Perhaps that's why Daphne brought you here...

lines.speaker: 테이션
lines.text: Have you found Levi of Elias, then?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not yet...
(A sharp, powerful spray erupts before %s, binds Tation, and lifts him into the air.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Daphne...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I don't usually repeat an invitation, but I'll offer one more time.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Come to me. Let us welcome the night together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora, ignore Daphne's...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: May I set a condition?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: If that would please you.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I'll cooperate only until Levi's soul is whole...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora? What are you saying? Why would you suddenly cooperate with Daphne?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: %s, do you trust me? The words of an Agasura and a witch...? I...
Creak... creak...
(Before Pandora can finish, the uneven grinding of a mechanism sounds from somewhere.)
(Everyone turns instinctively toward the sound.)
(Cutting through the water droplets drifting around the Atlas Garden, a being neither bird, human, nor machine flies before them.)
(The bizarre creature, its beautiful silver-gray body covered in sharp spikes, looks around.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Metheus the gardener...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Metheus...?
(The expressionless creation of the gods reaches out, forming a fan edged with sharp blades where none existed before.)

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「You who cov▒t the wo▒ld's tr▒th... and s▒uls.」
(Metheus's voice, mixed with grotesque noise, echoes through the Atlas Garden.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: S-such power... I can barely stand.

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「In the g▒ds' st▒ad, I shall j▒dge you. So you may n▒t unl▒ck the tr▒th of the Atl▒s Garden...」
(Metheus swings its fan, and a razor wind whistles past %s.)
KRAAA-BOOOM!
(The wind destroys the garden's structures, sending them plummeting below. Each impact in the river raises a vast waterspout that reaches the garden.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: "You who covet the world's truth and souls. I shall test you in the gods' stead, so you cannot unlock the truth of the Atlas Garden..."

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: A manufactured being dares speak of passing judgment...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora...
(Metheus looks at the pair and spreads its fan wide.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: %s, do you trust me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I trusted you... That's how I came this far.
(Though %s's answer is uncertain, Pandora seems satisfied and smiles faintly.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Understood. Then for now, let's defeat the gardener together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If the garden is destroyed, it could fall onto the village. It's dangerous.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You really are different from me. In any case, after that, we'll deal with Daphne...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She's already disappeared with Levi... no, Tation. She's going to watch.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I really dislike her. But I suppose that's how she's survived.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Sigh. No choice, then. %s...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I'm going to trust you and do something too. So please keep trusting me to the end... Even if some of it doesn't make sense...
(The moment Pandora turns her gaze to Metheus, a violet magic circle spreads beneath its feet.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: As you trust Iris... As I cherish Levi...
(A razor-sharp whirlwind bursts from Metheus's bladed fan and rushes toward Pandora and %s.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Metheus is slowing down, %s.
(Pandora keeps casting magic circles around the garden to stop the debris destroyed by Metheus from falling into the river.)
(Metheus spins, preparing another immense gale. Seizing the opening, %s strikes its bladed fan.)
KRAAA-BOOM!
(The instant their powerful forces collide, an enormous column of water surges upward from the river and engulfs the garden.)
(Pandora hastily flings the garden's debris into an empty area, then flies toward %s, who slips and loses balance in the crashing waves.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Take my hand!!
(Pandora snatches %s's hand and rises into the air. The churning water below falls still.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. You saved me.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Metheus has stopped moving... Let's take a look...
(Pandora peers down at Metheus, then descends with the adventurer.)
(The fallen Metheus does not move as they approach. It seems to be waiting, as though it has something to say.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I know a divine creation guarding this garden wouldn't stop over so little. Say what you want to say.

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「...I have realized that none here covets this place's truth.」

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: So there is no truth left here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora, what...?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Keep listening to Metheus.

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「...I have realized this is no longer the world of gods I knew... Servants of the gods, I judged wrongly. The truth of this place is...」
(Before Metheus can finish, an unseen force bends its limbs and wings. It falls motionless from the impact.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: So you're the one who knows where the truth went. DAPHNE!!!!
(At Pandora's shout, a magic circle forms behind %s, erupting with tremendous magical power.)
(A moment later, Daphne slowly appears before them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne!
(The adventurer raises their weapon at the approaching Daphne, but her staff taps their shoulder first.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Stop.
(At Daphne's single word, %s's attempt to escape comes to a halt.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (M-my body won't move.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I thought everything would stop, but your mind is still awake... To think Medea would keep you alive even now.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Pandora cannot save you. I've confined your existence to the Reverse Side for a moment.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: She knows full well that she can do nothing, just as you could do nothing. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Daphne... How many witches have you killed to gain powers like these?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Now, Pandora. Since you still seem unable to decide, I'll offer a little help.
(As Daphne smiles, a familiar voice sounds from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 레비의 목소리
lines.text: 「Lady Pandora... I want you to...」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Levi... Where is he?)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...Levi, trust me. Very well, Daphne.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Yes, Pandora. I can see you've made up your mind. State your conditions.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Make a contract with me that you will never harm Levi.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: A contract with an Agasura... But the terms would be rather unusual.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: If I am what your wish gains you, stake your life as payment. Include the condition that if you touch Levi, you may be put to death.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: And I will remain with you only until Levi's soul is whole.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Hehe. Quite a few unexpected conditions, but a fair bargain.
(Smiling in satisfaction, Daphne taps the ground with her staff. An enormous droplet rises and bursts, dropping Tation onto the ground.)
(Pandora forms a magic circle that appears to use an Agasura's ritual. She cuts her hand and lets her blood fall into it.)
(Daphne approaches, watching the blood-fed magic circle glow hot.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Pandora, one question. An Agasura's contract is absolute, isn't it?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: It is like a transcendent being's curse. No god of Etoile can ever tamper with it...
(Daphne's expression changes. Alarmed, Pandora reaches for her, but Daphne has already appeared behind Tation.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Excellent, Pandora.
(At those words, thick branches growing from Daphne's staff burst through Tation's abdomen. Moments later, he falls beneath the garden along with the severed branches.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: N-no... Ugh... Aaaaaagh!!
(Blood surges from the magic circle, now crimson, and splashes onto Pandora's face.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Aaaaaah!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Pandora!! Pandora!! What's happening? I have to get out of here!!)
(Daphne looks between the suffering Pandora and %s.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Pandora, an Agasura's contract is absolute. What you're experiencing now is proof...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: No. I can't return to a beast's form here...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Calm down, Pandora.
(Daphne taps Pandora's shoulder with her staff. A moment later, Pandora's agonized screams cease, and she slumps to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Now you can come with me. And %s, it's over. You may return.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Daphne!! What did you do to Pandora? Ugh... Huh...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I-I can move. P-Pandora, are you all right?
(Pandora looks sadly at %s, who has reappeared.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I'm sorry. You trusted me, and I made a mistake...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Pandora will be coming with me now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What nonsense are you talking about?!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Gambling with one's lifespan must be an Agasura trait. Hehe. To add another clause in so little time...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: If Pandora herself harmed someone whose soul shared Levi's color, she wanted the witch bound by the contract to die as well...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: In binding herself to the contract, Pandora stipulated that she would remain with me until Levi's soul became whole.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: That's why I confirmed the terms. An Agasura's contract is absolute. So for now, I'll leave Levi as he is. That way, Pandora cannot leave me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's impossible...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Such impossible things happen even to gods. There's no reason they couldn't happen to an Agasura.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She's repeating what Hecate said...)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Pandora... I've sent Tation's soul to a safe place I know. Do you understand what that means?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Levi could meet his death at any moment, with his soul still incomplete.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: S-stop... I... I understand...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Follow me quietly. It's the only way you and Levi can live.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: And to think, I only cobbled together an imitation of Levi's voice, yet you fell for it. Pandora, you really are...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Oh, the real Levi is coming just now.
(Where Daphne points, the real Levi, dressed for travel, runs swiftly toward them.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Release Lady Pandora at once!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Levi?
(As the tip of Levi's Bironta spear nears Daphne's throat, she lowers her head and smiles softly.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Stop.
Thud.
(A tremendous sound rings out, and Levi falls where he stands. %s is likewise driven backward by a powerful impact.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Guh. Again...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Where is Lady Pandora? Where did that witch...?
(Levi looks around blankly, but there is nothing before him.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: %s, is this a witch's power?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Some of Daphne's powers were taken from witches she killed...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I understand. We must find Lady Pandora quickly...
(Levi stops and looks to one side.)
Creak... creak...
(The uneven grinding of machinery can be heard.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Metheus...?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: That is...
(The fallen Metheus's arms, legs, and wings twist through some unknown process, then return to their original shapes.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: This is no ordinary monster. %s, how should we fight it?

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「All within the garden, listen... The witches have gone.」

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「The witch erased your memories before leaving...」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I suspected as much. But how do you remember?

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「I was created by the gods at the Great Wall... I merely borrowed the memories held by the star...」

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「And with my present awareness, I will fight no more.」
(Metheus rises and gazes blankly at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「The gods split into two sides and fought. The living fight as well. Perhaps their reasons are not so different...」

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「For all who exist must prove themselves...」

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「Servants of the gods.」

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「I have nothing left to protect. With nothing to protect, my existence has no meaning.」

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「In a world where even that foolish truth is gone...」

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「Servants of the gods. Do you wish the black moon to become the world's truth?」

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: The black moon... Dark Moon?

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「The garden will remain here, looking down upon the world. If you return, be prepared to destroy this body as you did today.」

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「Unless you wish to act according to the will of one who does not love the world...」
(Finishing its words, Metheus slowly rises into the sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait! Don't go yet. I have a question...
(Metheus looks down at %s as it ascends.)

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「I will answer only what I know.」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did the garden vanish and then return?
(The moment Metheus speaks, Levi doubles over in pain.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Uuuuaaaaagh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Levi, cover your ears!!
(With those final words, Metheus flies into the sky without looking back and disappears.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: %s, what did that monster say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can't hear the gods' language without permission.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: The gods' language... Then that creature is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A creation of the gods, made to guard the truth of this place... And...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Levi everything: Iris's request, my arrival at Laran Road, and my meeting with Pandora.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: ...I see.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Lady Pandora did it for me... But even so, such a choice...
(After hearing the full story, Levi bows his head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how did you get here, Levi? I was told only those connected to the gods could enter...
(In answer to %s's question, Levi takes a pure white feather from his clothing.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: The witch Daphne tricked me by saying she intended to kill Lady Pandora. Then she trapped me on the Reverse Side of the Aegir Ruins.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Somehow, the angel found me and freed me... She asked whether I was the Levi you were searching for, %s...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Then she gave me this and told me to go to the garden.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I do now...?)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: %s... I-I can sense Lady Pandora's magic nearby.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?
(Levi raises his head and looks around.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: We should go outside.
(No sooner has he spoken than Levi runs back the way they came.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He said he's connected to Pandora's magic, so he's probably right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know... Let's go. Maybe we'll learn something there.

steps.name: Pandora's Box
steps.objective: Talk to [Pandora] on 「Laran Road」, then turn in the quest to [Yeonhee] in 「Luria Village」.

lines.text: (Following Levi through the droplets circling the garden, the adventurer draws closer to Laran Road.)
(They arrive at the place where they first entered the garden.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The enormous droplet we used to enter is still here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Levi?
(As Levi stares at one spot, Pandora, who vanished from the garden, appears beside him.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Lady Pandora, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Even now, you worry about me, Levi...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I'm sorry I came too late...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: No. I'm the one who's sorry...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I'm sorry to both you and %s.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I made the wrong choice and opened something that should never have been opened.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I should never have gone to the garden...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Still, I'm glad I can say goodbye before leaving...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Lady Pandora...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I know what you want to say. An Agasura's contract is binding... There's no way around it.
(Unable to hide the sorrow in her eyes, Pandora quietly draws Levi's hands toward her. Understanding, he lets her hold them.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Levi...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I'll come back. I promise...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Lady Pandora...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: ...An Agasura's contract may offer no escape, but perhaps a witch's power will.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Until then, I may have no choice but to follow Daphne...
(Pandora's voice trails off as she gently pushes Levi's hands away.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: That's enough now... And %s, Tation's body drifted elsewhere. You won't find it here. We can only hope it's found later...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I never wanted this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You had no choice.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Thank you... for trusting me to the end...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Levi...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Go back to Jiendia at once.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Lady Pandora...

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I want you to return to Jiendia, Levi. Then, whenever that day comes, I'll be able to wait happily for you at the mansion.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I haven't given up hope yet...
(Pandora turns away. Dense shadows approach as though they have been waiting.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: ...Lady Pandora!!
(Levi reaches for her, but Pandora has already vanished into the darkness.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: This can't be... We'd only just found each other again...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Levi...
(Levi stares blankly at the spot where Pandora disappeared.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Levi, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I'm all right. I'm worried about Lady Pandora, but... %s, I'll return to Elias.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You will? Oh, thank you...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: It's my promise to Lady Pandora... You needn't worry about the rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Then, %s, please take care of Iris. I'll see you again.
(Levi bows, then hurries away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I suppose the result is what Iris asked for, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: After what happened to Pandora... And what Metheus said still troubles me...
「The g▒ds betr▒yed...」
「...l▒fe its▒lf. Th▒t is wh▒...」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because the gods betrayed life...
(Looking up, the adventurer sees the garden still floating in the sky, filled with an ominous air.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How much is this world hiding...? Sigh. Iris... How much more will we have to do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd better return to the village... The garden's appearance alone must have confused everyone...

steps.name: The Garden That Never Fades
steps.objective: Finish talking to [Yeonhee] and [Helena] in 「Luria Village」, then turn in the quest to [Helena].

lines.text: (Yeonhee gazes quietly at the sky, then looks around. When a familiar figure seems about to pass her by, she softly calls their name.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Yeonhee. There you are.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Did you find Levi?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks to your help, I found him quickly.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Then why are you alone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He was busy. After we met, he returned straight to Jiendia... to the Kingdom of Elias.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Has anything happened in the village while I was gone?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Like what?
(Yeonhee looks utterly puzzled.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She doesn't seem to know either... If anyone had noticed something, the village wouldn't be so quiet...)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Do you mean something like Aie Island...? Oh, I promised. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Then perhaps you mean those people...
(Where Yeonhee looks, a group of people who do not appear to be villagers stands gathered.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That is...

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: They seem to be mages from the Silvaria Empire's Magic Bureau and knights belonging to the council.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are they here...?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I'm afraid I don't know...
(Yeonhee looks puzzled, then smiles brightly as something occurs to her.)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Anyway, %s, Leon invited me to dinner. Would you like to join us?

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Excuse me, young lady.
(Helena appears without warning and takes %s by the wrist.)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Madam?

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Our adventurer has a prior engagement with me... Perhaps they forgot the time. They've only just arrived.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? What do you...?

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: You may have plenty of time ahead of you, %s, but I don't have much left. You should have come sooner.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Helena, don't say that! I-I'm sorry. I should have come earlier!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But why should I have come earlier? Oh... She's doing this deliberately...)

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I'll forgive you.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: You mustn't keep an elderly lady waiting, %s. Hehe. She's willing to forgive you, so do apologize properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Then have a lovely time, %s. I'll see you later.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: And I hope you make many happy memories in Luria, young lady.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Thank you, madam. Since fate has brought us together... Would you accept this?
(Yeonhee takes something from her bag and shows it to Helena.)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: It's a norigae, a traditional hanging ornament from Elias. A skilled artisan made it, and it's beautiful. I thought it would suit you.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Oh, what a precious gift. Thank you, young lady. Its craftsmanship is every bit as fine as the work of Glaston's artisan quarter.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: May I invite you over another time? I'd like to chat about the history of Jiendia and Freios...
(Yeonhee's eyes sparkle.)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: O-of course! I've been hoping to hear your insights. A conversation with such a great archaeologist... I'm truly looking forward to it!

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Hehe. Thank you for thinking so highly of me. I'll send Leon for you later. Come by when you have time.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Thank you, madam.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Shall we go now, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...? Of course...

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: ...Goodbye, %s! Goodbye, madam!

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Hmm... So something is happening after all? Oh well. There's nothing I can do about it.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I'm sorry. I must have startled you, appearing so suddenly.
(Helena begins speaking over tea that seems to have been prepared in advance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not at all. But why did you call me over?

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: That young lady is traveling through Freios with the council's support.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, really? I didn't know...

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: So you didn't. The council's knights and the Bureau's mages had just arrived, so I brought you here.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: As long as you're with me, they won't touch you here.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I may be imperial royalty in name only, but it has its uses. And Her Majesty did ask a favor of me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Her Majesty?

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Kaina is always like this. She sends letters full of things I can't make sense of.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: She said that after the young man named Levi left, you would return, and asked me to look after you for a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Her Majesty said so, I should listen. Moving carelessly could bring danger...

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Exactly.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: And Aaron is watching us from over there, so we should be careful.
(For a moment, the adventurer meets Aaron's eyes, then ignores him and returns their attention to Helena.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When I met him at Nereis Gateway, he said he handled minor matters. In fact, he was the council chairman...

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: So you've met Aaron. A snake of a man... But that isn't what matters now...

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Stay at my house for a while and watch how things develop. Since Her Majesty asked me to do this, you should hear from her soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: When the time is right, will you explain those ruins in the sky? I seem to be the only one who can see them...
